generation.forced_text:
As she stepped into junior-high gym in a blue uniform and yellow cleates she noticed for once there would likely never enough cleatees, she felt like the sole target and her gaze linger towards a small cluster where one, in her size was waiting in between them all to make it easier, if it was at some level easier for the girls than boys she had learned.

Her heart skipped, the small gap she thought of, now had eyes and it looked to meet with, the only other eye to be there in between those that seemed too distant.

When class arrived her friends all ran in with their friends she had to follow along as best. In between she saw them again as friends in the cluster but now one girl from it would walk alone with others in an adjacent one that had more of those in them so her eye could look towards it for once. With each stride
